description: A shell script for automating the creation, deletion, and management of a Kubernetes kind cluster with auto-detection of container engine (docker or podman). It includes argument parsing, provider detection, prerequisite checks, cluster creation, and status handling.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Prints informational messages in blue color.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Prints success messages in green color.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints warning messages in yellow color.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints error messages in red color and exits.

methods.name: provider_installed
methods.description: Checks if a container engine (docker or podman) is installed.

methods.name: provider_responsive
methods.description: Checks if the container engine responds (docker info or podman info).

methods.name: detect_provider
methods.description: Detects and returns the available container engine (docker or podman).
